info.title: Smart Classroom API
info.description: REST contract for the web frontend. Errors are {code, message}.

post.description: Changes the password and signs out every other session of this user.

get.description: Admin: the backend configuration that matters operationally (no secrets).

post.description:
Start/Pause/Resume/Stop from the web Live page. The command goes to the device, which acts as if
its button was pressed; the result arrives as `lecture.status` on the live socket (202 = sent).

patch.description: Lecturer correction of one transcript line (master plan: manual transcript editing).

post.description: Publishes the lecture's study material (notes, summary, key terms, questions) to students.

patch.description: Admin: rename/move a device or change its microphone settings (sent on its next connection).

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Plain text. Never rendered as HTML.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: Recording is paused on the device.

level_dbfs.title: Level Dbfs
level_dbfs.description: Microphone level over the last status interval.

mic_ok.title: Mic Ok
mic_ok.description: False after 60 s of silence while recording.

pending_chunks.title: Pending Chunks
pending_chunks.description: Audio chunks on the device not yet acknowledged.

gain.title: Gain
gain.description: Effective microphone gain sent to the device.

token.title: Token
token.description: Shown once. Provision it into the device NVS; only its hash is stored.

start.title: Start
start.description: Unicode code-point offset into text (end exclusive below).

subject.description: null for an 'Untitled' lecture started on the device

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: Wall-clock start; transcript offsets are relative to it.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: Capture is paused on the device; status stays 'recording'.

audio_available.title: Audio Available
audio_available.description: False once the retention policy deleted the audio.

consent_confirmed.title: Consent Confirmed
consent_confirmed.description: Recording consent confirmed by the lecturer (required).

start_ms.title: Start Ms
start_ms.description: Where the topic starts in the transcript.

version.title: Version
version.description: Optimistic concurrency token sent back on PATCH.

llm_model.title: Llm Model
llm_model.description: Empty when no Bedrock model is configured.

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.description: Audio never received (identical on every page).

transliteration.title: Transliteration
transliteration.description: ISO 15919 romanisation for te/hi; null for en.

edited.title: Edited
edited.description: Corrected by the lecturer after transcription.

password.title: Password
password.description: Initial password; the user changes it later.
